_why: The pinned answers for fixtures/memory/corpus. TWO independent implementations must reproduce these: tools/memory (TypeScript, on Bun) and bin/memory-lint.sh (POSIX sh, for CI where Bun is absent). Neither is the arbiter; this file is. Asserting one against the other would let them drift together and still agree.

corpus._ignored: assets/logo.svg is not markdown; .agents/memory/hidden-note.md is an L3 store (a different scope, CONTRACTS/memory-format.md); indexes/derived.md is the derived tier.
corpus._nodes_why: 17 notes minus the 2 duplicate carriers of the colliding slug — a graph node is a slug. The self-link in graph-hub.md is deliberately NOT an edge.

document_frequency._why: 'fixture' is carried by every indexed note and 'parquet' by exactly one. That gap is the whole IDF assertion: df must be counted per-DOCUMENT over body+title+tags, never per-occurrence.

queries._why: THE discriminating case. Without an IDF term the decoy note common-term-spam (60 occurrences of the universal token, nothing rare) wins this query outright — measured on this corpus at N=17: 2.3736 vs 2.2048. With IDF the rare-term note wins and the decoy falls below the relative cut entirely. The claim is a change of RANK ORDER, not of score, and the assertion in memory-engine.test.ts checks the order — these figures are here to be re-derivable, so re-measure them if the corpus changes.
The token exists only in a title. Drop field weighting and this returns nothing.
The token exists only in tags.
TELOS/ is in scope by decision. Narrowing the walker silently would break this.

tie-alpha.md and tie-beta.md have byte-identical bodies, so they score identically and the order is decided entirely by the tie-break. Ties break on relPath, so alpha precedes beta. Without this pair an unstable sort passes every other assertion in the suite — measured: it did.
Zero hits is a legitimate answer and must exit 0 — a hook that treats 'nothing found' as failure is a hook that gets disabled.

graph_traversal._why: Breadth-first, nearest first, ties broken by slug. bm25-rare-term is reached at distance 2 only via its INBOUND related: edge to acme-corp, so a directed-only traversal returns four nodes instead of five.

grep_tier._why: D7's third degradation. The grep rung answers a different question (which notes mention every word) but must agree with the engine on this query, or the fallback is not a fallback.
